purpose: Extend the preserved OneCore corpus with every usable record from the enabled data sources, regardless of data class or modality source. Include imported datasets, bootstrap examples, generated curricula and owner-created examples in the same from-scratch training mix. Require usable text, tool-use, image, audio and video examples in train, validation and test; preserve independent splits and source-group/asset separation. Initialize OneCore from random weights and run 150 joint optimizer steps on GitHub Actions CPU, sampling each of the five task families once per optimizer update. Record per-source and per-data-class counts in the training lineage.
